MAGMOM_atom_by_atom_note: MAGMOM entries correspond to POSCAR sort=True order = ['C', 'H', 'O'].
purpose: Gas-phase CH3O reference for T1.18 adsorption energy (vacuum convention).
note: CH3O radical (open-shell doublet, S=1/2). POSCAR sort=True order = C H H H O; MAGMOM places unpaired μ on O. NUPDOWN=1 enforces total moment = 1 μ_B.
workflow_before_submit: This dir is a STATIC (IBRION=-1, NSW=0) box-size sanity check in a 20.0 Å cubic box. DO NOT copy CONTCAR directly from ../CH3O_vacuum/ — that would carry the 15 Å lattice too. Run scripts/prepare_static_from_relax.py after CH3O_vacuum finishes; it extracts positions only and rewrites POSCAR here with the correct 20.0 Å cell + relaxed coordinates centered. Then submit. Target: |E(20 Å) − E(15 Å)| < 5 meV.
paired_with: CH3O_vacuum_15A_static and CH3O_vacuum_20A_static — same relaxed coordinates, different cell.
